Package models

Class SuiteClass

java.lang.Object
models.SuiteClass
public class SuiteClass extends Object
Represents a suite tier / class definition in the MIRAGE system.

A SuiteClass defines the category of a suite — its name (e.g. "Penthouse"), nightly rate, and the amenities that come with it. Multiple individual Suite records can share the same class, meaning they all have the same rate and amenity set.

Database mapping: suite_class table.

  • Constructor Details

    • SuiteClass

      public SuiteClass(String className, double nightlyRate, String amenities)
      Creates a new SuiteClass with all required fields. classId is left at 0 until persisted and the key is set via setClassId(int).
      Parameters:
      className - the tier name; must not be null or blank
      nightlyRate - the nightly rate in USD; must be non-negative
      amenities - a description of included amenities; may be null
